name: coinmarketcap
description: Live and historical cryptocurrency market data from the official CoinMarketCap Model Context Protocol server. Search coins, get real-time quotes, global market metrics, technical analysis (RSI, MACD, MAs, Fibonacci), on-chain holder metrics, trending narratives, derivatives, and macro events across thousands of assets.

interface.shortDescription: Live and historical crypto market data via the official CoinMarketCap MCP server.
interface.longDescription: Connects the agent to CoinMarketCap's official hosted Model Context Protocol server (https://mcp.coinmarketcap.com/mcp) and exposes 12 professional tools covering cryptocurrency search, real-time quotes, global market metrics (total market cap, BTC/ETH dominance, Fear & Greed Index, Altcoin Season Index), per-coin and total-market technical analysis (RSI, MACD, SMA, EMA, Fibonacci, support / resistance), coin metadata and latest news, semantic search over the crypto knowledge base, trending narratives with the top tokens inside each, on-chain holder-distribution and whale metrics, derivatives (open interest, funding rates, liquidations), and upcoming macro events that may move the market. Authentication is a single header — set COINMARKETCAP_API_KEY with a key from https://pro.coinmarketcap.com/login. No local install, no subprocess — just a hosted HTTPS endpoint and your CMC Pro API key.
defaultPrompt: Use the CoinMarketCap skill whenever the user asks for cryptocurrency prices, market cap, volume, dominance, Fear & Greed, technicals (RSI, MACD, moving averages), holder distribution, trending narratives, or upcoming macro catalysts.
Always call `search_cryptos` first when a user mentions a coin by name or symbol — most other tools require the numeric CMC ID.
For market-wide questions, prefer `get_global_metrics_latest` and `get_crypto_marketcap_technical_analysis` over aggregating per-coin quotes.
